name: Contextual Relevance
description: Measures how well the generated continuation adheres to the given context, ensuring that the conversation flow remains consistent and coherent.

name: Factual Accuracy
description: Evaluates the accuracy of any factual information presented in the generated continuation, including sports statistics, player backgrounds, or events.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and overall coherence of the generated continuation, ensuring that the response is well-structured and easy to understand.

name: Engagement
description: Measures the ability of the generated continuation to maintain the conversation's engaging and interesting nature, encouraging further discussion.

name: Creativity
description: Evaluates the creativity and originality of the generated continuation, considering the use of unique phrases, ideas, or perspectives.

name: Grammatical Correctness
description: Assesses the grammatical correctness of the generated continuation, ensuring that the response is free of errors and adheres to proper language rules.
